framer.free_tier: Free: Server API is free while in beta; Framer plans per-use pricing with a monthly free allowance later

penpot-api.notes: API is RPC-style (e.g. /api/rpc/command/get-profile) with auto-generated reference docs, not a conventional OpenAPI/Swagger file. Fully open source; can be self-hosted. MCP server runs locally (npx @penpot/mcp, http://localhost:4401/mcp); no hosted endpoint.

v0-platform-api-vercel.notes: Different product from Vercel's core platform API; API access is tied to v0 plan credits rather than a standalone free signup. The official remote MCP server (v0.app/api/mcp) uses OAuth, not the API key.

circleci-api.notes: Use the v3 API for new work (v2 still supported). The mcp-server-circleci npm package is deprecated in favor of CircleCI's hosted MCP (mcp.circleci.com/v1/mcp, OAuth2 or personal API token) or CLI MCP mode.

docker-hub-api.notes: API is v2-beta; free/anonymous pulls are rate-limited. Docker's MCP Catalog/Toolkit offers 300+ containerized MCP servers. The hub-mcp server runs locally (stdio or self-run HTTP); no hosted endpoint.

gitlab-api.notes: GitLab's official MCP server is in beta (GitLab 18.6+) at https://<gitlab-host>/api/v4/mcp with OAuth dynamic client registration, on all tiers incl. Free; no GitLab-maintained multi-language SDK, but community libraries (python-gitlab, node-gitlab) exist.

maven-central-search.notes: Solr-style queries (g:, a:, v:, fc:); core=gav lists all versions. Sonatype may throttle heavy automated use. Sonatype's own Guide MCP (mcp.guide.sonatype.com/mcp, bearer token) covers dependency intelligence, not this search API.

pagerduty-api.notes: The self-hosted pagerduty-mcp-server repo is deprecated and archived; use the PagerDuty-hosted Remote MCP server (US: mcp.pagerduty.com/mcp, EU: mcp.eu.pagerduty.com/mcp).

postman-api.free_tier: Free plan: 10,000 Postman API calls/month; rate limits ~300 req/min general, stricter for specific endpoints
postman-api.notes: Reference docs are at learning.postman.com. The Postman API MCP server has full (/mcp), minimal (default, /minimal) and code (/code) variants; EU at mcp.eu.postman.com (API key only); npm @postman/postman-mcp-server.

activepieces.notes: MCP server URL is per-instance (https://your-instance.com/mcp); OAuth-based client auth, and connection secrets/API keys are never exposed through MCP tools. Endpoints docs say API key management is only in Platform and Enterprise editions.

arcade-dev.notes: First use of an OAuth-gated tool requires the human to approve a browser consent screen; token is then reused automatically. Team plan adds $0.10/auth event and $0.01/tool call beyond free quota. MCP gateways: https://api.arcade.dev/mcp/<gateway-slug>.

composio.auth_hint: x-api-key: <api_key> (org-level keys: x-org-api-key); per-toolkit connections use managed OAuth

make-api-mcp.free_tier: Free tier: 1,000 credits/month, 2 active scenarios; Make API access requires Core plan or higher
make-api-mcp.notes: MCP scenario-run tools are available on all Make plans, management tools on paid plans only; you pay for operations consumed when scenarios run. Token variant: https://<zone>/mcp with Authorization: Bearer <MCP_TOKEN>.

merge-agent-handler.free_tier: Free tier: 2,000 credits/month for prototyping/testing; production usage needs a paid Pro ($1,000/mo, 25,000 credits) or Enterprise plan
merge-agent-handler.notes: Separate product from Merge's classic Unified API (HRIS/ATS/CRM sync); Agent Handler is the AI-agent-facing tool-calling layer. All plans include unlimited registered users and tool packs.

n8n-api.free_tier: Free: self-hosted Community Edition (open source, unlimited); n8n Cloud trial has no API access
n8n-api.notes: REST API manages workflows/executions/credentials/users, not per-node business logic. Built-in instance-level MCP server at https://<instance>/mcp-server/http (OAuth or Bearer token), plus MCP Server Trigger nodes. Scoped API keys need Enterprise plan.

nango.notes: Nango is primarily an auth/proxy broker (open source). It also hosts a per-session MCP server (Streamable HTTP): POST /sessions returns mcp_url + session_token (Bearer). Free self-hosting is not offered outside the Enterprise (BYOC) plan.

paragon-actionkit.free_tier: Trial: free trial only; no lasting free tier confirmed; Pro/Enterprise pricing by quote
paragon-actionkit.notes: Paragon's embedded-iPaaS platform and ActionKit are sales-quoted after a free trial. The ActionKit MCP server is self-hosted (Docker) from github.com/useparagon/paragon-mcp; no hosted endpoint.

pipedream-connect.notes: Requires a Pipedream project plus client ID/secret/project ID to call the MCP server; managed auth handles end-user OAuth for connected apps. Send Bearer token plus x-pd-project-id, x-pd-environment, x-pd-external-user-id, x-pd-app-slug headers.

superglue.notes: Open-source, self-serve integration/migration agent for enterprise systems (NetSuite, SAP, Sage Intacct, Dynamics). Default MCP server at https://<api-endpoint>/mcp (OAuth or creator API key); custom servers at /mcp/{orgId}/{serverName}.

zapier-mcp-ai-actions.free_tier: Free tier: 100 tasks/month; each successful MCP tool call uses 2 tasks (~50 calls/month); more on paid plans
